scenes.text: Your payments provider had a two-second blip. Your app kept it down for ten minutes. Claude traced it to your retry loop.
Every failed request retried instantly. Thousands of clients, all hitting the server at once. A thundering herd.
So Claude added exponential backoff: wait one second, then two, then four, then eight.
But if every client waits exactly one second, they all come back together. Random jitter spreads them out, and the server recovers.
And a cap of five tries, so nobody retries forever. Back off, add jitter, and know when to quit.
